text:
rheotool-2 landed in eafb5b0, refused at the stage and flagged in the bundle.
At the stage: card.held_named matches a science_task against each held[] item not yet released. Phrases are the item cut at brackets, commas, 'and' and 'or', without a leading article; a phrase counts at two words or more, or as one identifier. card.problems refuses the card ('narrow it in this revision, or a person releases the item').
In the bundle: the goal keeps the science_task of the revision it was made from, so a later intake that narrows it does not reach the Role. The Designer therefore appends a sentence after 'Science task:' naming which of it is held, its reason in CAPABILITIES.json. An item whose name carries a digit is not named (B6).
On the clone's strings, revision 2 is caught (shear viscosity; normal stress difference) and the narrowed science task matches nothing.
Tested in test_science_task_held on an engine, a spectrometer and the echo request built end to end, the last passing the gate in --strict. With the matcher out, 5 of 8 fail; the three that pass are controls.
Open, yours if wanted: understand-purpose could say that a goal is revised when an intake revision narrows the science task; the Designer reads the goal as it stands.
meta_agent/tests 278 OK (a private TMPDIR: another seat's Designer rebuild in the test folder left an S6 copy in the shared temp folder while it ran), contracts/tests 113 OK.
